summary: Synectic is a Tasmanian-owned chartered accounting and advisory firm (Devonport, Launceston, Hobart, about 40 staff) led by owner and CEO Gareth Atkins. It is a Xero Platinum Partner with audit as a core service, offers virtual CFO work, and has built a Synectic Digital line around data frameworks and AI, including an in-house engineering effort on the Anthropic API.

claims.text: Synectic is a Tasmanian owned and operated chartered accounting and financial services firm with about 40 staff.
claims.quote: Synectic is a Tasmanian owned and operated Chartered Accounting and Financial Services firm.

claims.text: Gareth Atkins is Owner and CEO of Synectic Group on LinkedIn, current as of Nov 2026.
Gareth began as a trainee accountant at Synectic and became a Director in 2005; he is CEO and Accounting Director.
claims.quote: Gareth began his career at Synectic as a Trainee Accountant in 1991, becoming a Director in 2005.

claims.text: Synectic is a Xero Platinum Partner and won Xero's TAS Accounting Partner of the Year in 2017.
claims.quote: As Xero Platinum Partners, we have a wealth of experience in making Xero easy

claims.text: Synectic has a team of 40 staff across offices in Devonport, Hobart and Launceston.
claims.quote: With a team of 40 brilliant and dedicated staff

claims.text: Synectic announced Synectic Digital to help businesses build data frameworks, generate automated analytics and capture AI opportunities.
claims.quote: We're expanding our services to help businesses set up data frameworks, generate automated analytics, and capture the huge opportunities of AI

claims.text: Synectic advertised for a Data and AI Analyst for its Digital and Advisory team in Devonport.
claims.quote: We are seeking a talented Data and AI Analyst to join our expanding Digital and Advisory team in Devonport.

claims.text: A Synectic software engineer says he builds the firm's internal platform including BI dashboards and AI tooling on the Anthropic API.

Synectic describes audit as a core service under Gareth's leadership.

claims.quote: celebrated director Gareth Atkins ' 30 years of service with the firm.

hooks.text: Synectic Digital sells AI and data frameworks to clients; applying the same to internal reconciliations is a natural step.
Xero Platinum Partner with audit as a core service: traceable automation matters.
Virtual CFO work depends on clean month-end reconciliations.

risks.text: Synectic is building internal AI tooling on the Anthropic API, so it may prefer to build rather than buy.
Tasmania-based; the firm is more advisory and audit weighted than pure bookkeeping.

gaps: No podcast or press interviews with Gareth found.
Revenue and exact bookkeeping volumes not confirmed.
